max_temp_prediction: Best estimate is approximately 85.5°F. The NWP model consensus of 84–85°F is the primary anchor, with the NWS forecast of 86°F as an upside reference; the current warming rate of +1.8°F/hr over ~5 remaining heating hours is mathematically consistent with reaching 85–87°F by the 14.6h predicted peak.
